damaged_excaliwood_wand: A splintered heirloom branch that still hums with faint power.
arcane_staff: A plain rod of polished ash, favoured by first-year scholars.
staff_of_conjuring: Its carved grooves drink in mana and spit it back out as spells.
swiftcaster_wand: Light and twitchy, built for rapid-fire casting.
ethereal_wand: Half-transparent wood that flickers when you look at it too long.
elderwood_cane: A gnarled walking stick with more patience than power.
toy_blade: A painted wooden sword someone enchanted as a joke. It works.
microcosmic_embrace: A tiny cosmos cradled in glass. All wands cost x80% MP.
steadfast_will: A heavy, unbending rod that rewards a steady hand.
featherweight_wand: Barely weighs a thing. Post-slot charges 3 energy per cast.
harmonic_resonance: Every note splits into a chorus: fires 5 volleys at once.
natural_convergence: Living vines coil around its shaft. All wands regenerate +3 MP/s.
wooden_stick: It is, frankly, a stick. Magic finds a way anyway.
tuning_fork: Strike it once and the air rings for minutes.
novices_grimoire: A dog-eared primer for apprentices. Summoning spells cost x90% MP.
guiding_fable: A storybook whose pages turn themselves toward the right answer.
old_wand: Worn smooth by a dozen previous owners.
777: Luck runs through its core. Post-slot charges 1.7 energy per enemy hit.
time_stasis: Its sand never quite falls. Post-slot charges 2 energy per meter moved.
new_wand: Fresh from the workshop, still smelling of varnish.
elders_grip: The handle is shaped to a hand far older than yours.
frenzy_enchanter: It vibrates eagerly between casts. Post-slot charges 4 energy per cast.
viscous_fang: A curved tooth that drips something unpleasant.
venomous_bite: A serpent's jaw on a stick. Spells cost x80% MP.
arc_of_justice: A bright, bowed rod that hums with righteous static.
tricolor_scepter: Three gems vie for control; spells may shift to a random base colour.
defiant_nature: It refuses to point the way you want: spells always fire backward.
shamanic_dagger: A ritual knife that sips little. Spells cost x70% MP but deal x70% final damage.
shattered_scepter: Its crown is cracked, yet the pieces still obey.
rusty_blaster: Corroded and loud. Final damage x120%; post-slot charges 20 energy per 45 damage dealt.
energy_reservoir: A brimming vessel of stored charge. Post-slot charges 4 energy per enemy hit.
trident: Three prongs, three paths: fires 3 volleys at once.
soul_devouring_orb: Fires 3 volleys at once and feeds on the fallen: post-slot charges 30 energy per kill.
legacy_of_ancestors: Old voices whisper through it. Post-slot charges 15 energy per second.
vow_of_honor: Pain only hardens its oath. Post-slot charges 33 energy each time you take damage.
radiant_bouquet: A bundle of glowing blossoms; spells may bloom in random colours.
conch_whistle: Sea winds follow its call. +20% move speed while held; post-slot charges 3 energy per meter moved.
sacrificial_dagger: A blade that spares its wielder: self-inflicted damage is cut to 1%.
energizer_wand: Rewards big spending: +50% spell damage when a cast drains at least 30% of this wand's max MP.
deed_witness: A sealed contract that enlarges promises. All wands' spell areas +50%.
swiftshot_staff: Better on the belt than in hand: MP regen x20% while held, x150% while stowed.
legion_banner: Rallies the troops. +15% crit chance; post-slot charges 6 energy per enemy hit.
expanding_container: It holds more than it should. Triggers 2 casts at once; all wands' max MP x130%.
double_flute: Two pipes, one tune. Post-slot charges 2.2 energy per enemy hit.
trichord_lute: Strum all three strings: fires 3 volleys at once.
sorcerers_oath: A pledge etched in silver. All wands regenerate +5 MP/s.
restless_heart: It never sits still: spell recoil pushes you the other way.
witchs_broomstick: Bristles and all. You can fly while holding it.
tome_of_endless: Its last page is always blank, waiting for one more spell.
heavy_impact: A brutal, weighty rod meant for slow, crushing blows.
sigil_of_temperance: A calm, balanced emblem that tempers wild magic.
twin_headed_wand: Two tips squabble over which one gets to cast next.
swift_spellblade: A duelist's blade. +40% move speed while held.
book_of_tranquility: Stillness is power: post-slot charges 20 energy per second standing still; no recoil while standing.
handy_wand: Reliable and pocket-sized. Post-slot charges 3 energy per cast.
ripple_wand: Spells cost x150% MP, but each cast has a 5% chance to refill its MP instantly.
portable_library: A whole shelf of spells folded into one tidy volume.
wand_of_convergence: Twin channels merge at the tip: fires 2 volleys at once.
warlocks_satchel: A battered leather bag that clinks with half-finished charms.
aquaflow_staff: Water pours from it in wide, unruly arcs.
star_strider: Forged from a fallen star that never stopped moving.
festive_wand: Every victory is a party. Post-slot charges 20 energy per kill.
grannys_needle: Knits spells as neatly as it knits scarves.
voltage_stone: Crackling and hungry: spells cost x110% MP; post-slot charges 22 energy per 45 damage dealt.
magic_conductor: Channels raw mana with barely any loss.
stellar_horn: Blown once, and the constellations answer.
serpentine_waltz: Spells sway and coil as if dancing.
asteroid: A chunk of space rock that's cheap to fuel: spells cost x90% MP.
energized_orb: A spare battery: other wands draw from its MP when their own runs dry.
restless_fey: A fidgety spirit that prefers the bag: MP regen x30% while held, x180% while stowed.
plague_bearer: Its tip is crusted with something best left untouched.
dormant_whisker: Sleeps until blood is spilled. Post-slot charges 90 energy per kill.
siegemaker: Engineered for walls. Fires 3 volleys at once; spells cost x130% MP.
frozen_touch: Frost blooms where it points: fires 2 volleys at once.
kingdoms_guardian: An old sentinel's staff. Post-slot charges 35 energy per second.
dark_young: Something gnarled and hungry sprouted this. It flings spells everywhere.
archmages_wand: The badge of a master, heavy with authority.
shapeshifter: Never the same twice. +70% crit chance; final damage x70%.
rainbow_electroweb: A prismatic net of lightning. Spells cost x90% MP.
collectors_staff: Studded with trinkets gathered from countless journeys.
the_heirless: A relic with no line left to claim it.
the_shadeless: Casts no shadow. Post-slot charges 5 energy per meter moved.
the_lightless: Swallows light as it fires. Spells cost x70% MP; post-slot charges 3.3 energy per enemy hit.
the_formless: Shapes itself around your pain. Spells cost x90% MP; post-slot charges 100 energy each time you take damage.
the_featureless: Smooth as an egg, with no mark to tell its maker.
the_faultless: Flawless and merciless. Post-slot charges 130 energy per kill.
the_boundless: No limit anyone has found yet.
the_sourceless: Power without origin: triggers 3 casts at once.
the_wordless: Speaks only in silence. Spells cost x120% MP; post-slot charges 66 energy per second.
the_nameless: Whatever it was once called has long been forgotten.
wand_of_focus: Demands full attention: final damage x120%; MP regen x150% while held, x50% while stowed.
omen_of_doom: Each step brings the end nearer. Post-slot charges 7.5 energy per meter moved.
clearwater_resonance: A gentle, frugal chime: spells cost x30% MP and deal x30% final damage; post-slot charges 1.5 energy per cast.
shard_of_time: A splinter of frozen moments. All wands regenerate +8 MP/s.
stellar_drift: A drifting galaxy on a rod. Fires 5 volleys at once; spells cost x200% MP; +20% crit chance.
quadruple_staff: Each spell is copied four times and fired in all four directions; spells cost x150% MP and deal x50% final damage.
